notes.id: Selama menempuh pendidikan sarjana di program studi Administrasi Publik, saya mendalami berbagai aspek tata kelola pemerintahan dan manajemen sektor publik. Fokus pembelajaran saya mencakup analisis dan perumusan kebijakan publik, strategi pembangunan regional, serta reformasi birokrasi. Selain pemahaman teoretis, saya juga dibekali keterampilan manajerial dan operasional yang praktis. Hal ini meliputi manajemen sumber daya manusia di sektor publik, manajemen proyek, penerapan sistem informasi manajemen, tata kelola kearsipan, hingga administrasi keuangan dan perkantoran secara umum.
notes.en: During my undergraduate studies in the Public Administration program, I delved into various aspects of governance and public sector management. My core studies covered public policy analysis and formulation, regional development strategies, and bureaucracy reformation. Alongside theoretical knowledge, I was also equipped with practical managerial and operational skills. These include public sector human resources management, project management, the application of management information systems, archives management, as well as general financial and office administration.

degree.id: Teknik Komputer & Informatika, Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak

notes.id: Tempat saya membangun dasar pemrograman, basis data, jaringan komputer, dan pengembangan aplikasi web.
notes.en: Where I built my foundation in programming, databases, computer networking, and web application development.
